Definition: adverb from a compound of G4183 and G3313; in many portions, i.e. variously as to time and agency (piecemeal):--at sundry times.
BiblicalUsage: Polymeros means in many portions, at sundry times. The writer to the Hebrews opens with it: God spoke in time past to the fathers by the prophets at sundry times and in divers manners.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God never spoke carelessly or all at once, but piece by piece across the ages until the full picture came in his Son.
